## What
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-review-defenses.sh` — a one-shot migration script that extracts all `# REVIEW-DEFENSE:` inline comments from the repo, binds each to the primary owning ticket (most-recent epic story touching that file), writes bound records to TrackerDefenseStore, and writes UNBOUND records to a Legacy REVIEW-DEFENSE corpus ticket.

## Algorithm
```bash
# 1. Find all # REVIEW-DEFENSE: comments
grep -rn '# REVIEW-DEFENSE:' --include='*.md' --include='*.sh' --include='*.py' .

# 2. For each comment:
#    a. Extract file path + line number + defense text
#    b. Find primary owning ticket: git log --follow -- <file> | grep 'ticket:' | head -1
#       OR use .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=story with file path heuristic
#    c. If ticket found: defense_store_write <ticket_id> <defense_json>
#    d. If no ticket: write to UNBOUND_LEGACY_TICKET (create if doesn't exist)

# 3. Delete inline comments (sed -i '/#[[:space:]]*REVIEW-DEFENSE:/d' <file>)
```

## UNBOUND handling
Create a legacy corpus ticket if it doesn't exist:
```bash
LEGACY_TICKET=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket create epic 'Legacy REVIEW-DEFENSE Corpus (migration)' --priority 3 2>/dev/null || ...)
```

## Dry-run mode
`migrate-review-defenses.sh --dry-run` outputs what would be migrated without writing or deleting.
